Sub-Saharan Africa

Season near baseline

Sub-Saharan Africa logged 26,643 cases in October 2026, tracking near the seasonal baseline.

Year-to-date totals sit at 79,001, tracking near the expected burden.

Data refreshed: 04 November 2026

Burkina Faso is estimated to have experienced 51,938 cases this year to date. This is 1.3× the number of cases reported in an average year. This year the dengue situation in Burkina Faso is above average.
